pages.raw_title: Peloton: Innovative exercise equipment and personalized workout plans
pages.raw_meta: Discover Peloton’s fitness equipment and personalized workout plans. From cardio to strength, find an exercise program that keeps you motivated and on track.
raw_blocks: Meet the next generation of Treads
Run, walk, and train your way.
Shop Tread Flex Shop Tread Vision
Three new Treads. Endless ways to move.
Everything you need to move at your own pace. Every day flexibility. Made to fit.
Get your game plan from Peloton IQ. Then run it.
Choose what you’re working towards and Peloton IQ will build your plan. Move with confidence whether it’s gaining strength, boosting endurance, or more.
No more guessing. Peloton IQ helps create your very own weekly personalized plans that adapt to your goals and keep you on track.
Your plan is ready. Just show up and we’ll handle the rest.
Whatever you’re feeling, there’s an expert instructor who lives for it. From running and cycling to strength, yoga, and more, every class is built around a community that shows up together.²
Class is always in session
Some days you know exactly what you need. Other days you discover it. Choose from over 10,000 classes across more than 15 workout types and find one that moves you.

Move with millions of Members by your side
“Peloton taught me to run and gave me the courage and strength to complete the half-marathons.”
Raquel from New York, NY
"The instructors made me feel like it was okay to be a beginner; to start with a walk."
“Through Peloton, I’ve discovered a love for fitness, an amazing platform, and so many incredible instructors.”
Kamryn from Los Angeles, CA
"The joy of Peloton is knowing that you can be safe in your body and move freely any time you wish."
Running is just the start
There’s more than one way to sweat, and everything you need to keep going. Check out all Peloton has to offer.
Your ride, your way. See how the Bike and Bike+ stack up and choose one that moves with you.
Look and train your best with instructor-approved styles, performance fabrics, and exclusive collabs.
A full body workout, every time. Experience game changing cardio and strength like never before.
Running, cycling, strength, yoga, Pilates, and more—all under one membership.¹
Includes a 12-month Limited Warranty, a 3-year Belt & Motor Guarantee, and a 5-year Frame Guarantee.
As low as 0% APR² and $0 down
Finance with Affirm, so you can work out daily and pay monthly.
Use pre-tax funds to pay for your equipment with Truemed.³
If it’s not for you, we’ll pick it up and refund your order, excluding the return fee. Terms apply.⁴
